text: Repository search used root alchemy.run.ts although file lives under apps/api; a root layout map would prevent failed lookup
rtk pnpm --filter @emi/api typecheck was rewritten as root tsc, hiding package filtering; preserve pnpm filter/run semantics

rtk pnpm --filter <package> typecheck rewrites to a root tsc invocation, losing pnpm filter semantics and surfacing unrelated project-reference errors; preserve filtered run scripts or document rtk pnpm limitation

jj squash --from @ --into @- <path> unexpectedly opens configured editor to combine descriptions in noninteractive agent session; suggest --use-destination-message or clearer hint before editor launch
Diagnostic command combined repo-relative paths with apps/api working directory; preflight should print cwd or commands should use workspace-root paths
Browser Playwright evaluate exposes no fetch function, blocking same-origin read-only API inspection; document this or add a safe GET helper
Session diagnostic exporter assumes post-auth user_id columns, so it cannot inspect historical pre-auth databases; detect schema capabilities and omit owner predicates for legacy DBs
Deployment README requires D1/R2 operator steps but workspace has no wrangler CLI dependency; add explicit install or API helper.
